site.heroBadge: Lombok South Sea Pearls • World-Class Natural Splendor
site.heroTitle: The Pure Radiance of Indonesia's Seas in Solid 18K Gold
site.heroDesc: South Sea pearl haute joaillerie (Pinctada maxima) harvested from the pristine cultivation waters of Sekotong & Medana, Lombok. Naturally blessed with eternal mirror luster, meticulously hand-set by master goldsmiths in certified solid 18K gold.
site.categorySubtitle: From opulent strand necklaces to certified loose investment pearls.
site.noProducts: No jewelry pieces match the selected filters.
site.terroirTitle: The Wonder of the Golden Oyster in Tropical Depths
site.terroirDesc: Lombok's Sekotong & Medana waters are globally renowned for their rich oceanic currents, stable tropical temperatures, and pristine clarity. Here, giant Pinctada maxima oysters are ethically nurtured for 24 to 36 months to yield thick, lustrous nacre with everlasting mirror brilliance.
site.why1Desc: Harvested ethically from Pinctada maxima oysters in Sekotong & Medana waters without artificial chemical enhancers.
site.why2Desc: Ring mountings, earrings, and necklace clasps are forged in hallmarked 750 (18K) gold and 925 sterling silver.
site.why3Desc: Every single pearl is accompanied by an independent gemological lab report attesting to its grade and origin.
site.why4Desc: 100% insured delivery across the archipelago in tamper-evident security seals and signature velvet presentation boxes.
site.eduSubtitle: The timeless criteria determining the value, luster, and longevity of saltwater pearls.
site.edu1Desc: Prestige saltwater pearls feature crisp, mirror-like reflections. When observed closely, facial contours are sharply reflected without blurred distortion.
site.edu2Desc: Substantial nacre forms after 24 to 36 months of ethical stewardship in Lombok depths, ensuring colors never fade across lifetimes.
site.edu3Desc: Pearls are organic treasures. Adorn your pearls after cosmetics have dried, and cleanse gently with a soft cotton cloth after wear.
site.ctaConciergeTitle: Seeking Guidance for the Perfect Pearl?
site.ctaConciergeDesc: Each pearl bears unique luster, overtone nuances, and dimensions. Our resident gemologists are at your service to curate the perfect heirloom for your style.
site.footerDesc: An atelier devoted to authentic Indonesian South Sea pearls harvested from Sekotong & Medana, Lombok. Hand-set with solid 18K gold and certified natural diamonds.
site.footerSubscribed: ✓ Thank you. You have been welcomed into our private atelier circle.
